Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. A couple of follow-ups from our finance team as we finish paperwork:

   - a vendor portal (SFTP)
   - direct email to billing@papertrail.com

3) Can you share a minimal invoice template or CSV layout so we can validate our accounting export?

Appreciate any formatting rules (tax ID, remit-to address, where to place line-item descriptions).

Attaching our standard supplier W-9 for your reference (W9_PaperTrail_2027.pdf).

Hi Emma — great to meet you earlier. Quick answers below, then looping in Marcus from procurement for details and AP on policy.

Summary (quick):
- Preferred: vendor portal / SFTP (best for machine ingestion).
- Acceptable fallback: emailed PDF to billing@redwood.com with PO# in the subject line.
- Consolidated weekly invoices: OK for low-volume suppliers but must include individual PO references per line.

Action items for PaperTrail: please complete our onboarding_form.pdf (attached) and then send one sample invoice using the attached minimal template. That lets AP validate mapping before going live.

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (please fill and return)

Marcus — can you confirm the PO stamping rule and any mandatory fields AP needs on the invoice?

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Emma Walsh <emma@papertrailprint.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission channels & setup questions

Thanks Vanessa, and thanks Emma. A few notes from procurement/AP perspective: we try to standardize so AP can auto-ingest wherever possible. Priorities below (ranked):

1) Portal/SFTP intake (preferred) — supports CSV or XML. If you can push via SFTP, we'll provide credentials and a brief spec.

2) Email to billing@redwood.com (fallback) — must be a single attachment (PDF or CSV). If email used, please format subject exactly like: "PO <PO_NUMBER> - PaperTrail Print - <InvoiceDate>". We rely on subject parsing for routing.

3) Consolidated invoice (weekly) — allowed if you include a CSV attachment inside the PDF (or a separate CSV) listing each PO and per-line amount. If you choose consolidated, each PO must be an independent row.

Mandatory invoice fields for automated processing (please include these exact labels):
- InvoiceNumber
- InvoiceDate (YYYY-MM-DD)
- RedwoodPONumber (or multiple rows tied to PO)
- LineDescription
- LineAmount
- TaxAmount
- TotalAmount
- RemitToName / RemitToAddress
- VendorTaxID

I attached a minimal_invoice_template.csv — please populate that sample and send it back as part of onboarding. Small vendors who cannot SFTP can continue via email but we will need a 1–2 week manual verification period.

FYI: PO stamping — a single PO reference at the header is acceptable only if every line clearly maps to that PO. For multi-PO shipments, please provide per-line PO numbers.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: minimal_invoice_template.csv (header row present)

From: monica_patel@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:05:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission channels & setup questions

Hi Emma — operational notes from AP:

- For emailed invoices: send to billing@redwood.com. Subject must be: "PO <PO_NUMBER> - PaperTrail Print - <InvoiceDate>" (this is non-negotiable for our parser).
- File types preferred: PDF (searchable) or CSV. If you only have images, please OCR before sending.
- For remittances: include RemitToAddress block and VendorTaxID on the first page.
- Payment terms: we'll default to Net 45 unless a negotiated PO states otherwise.
- Onboarding cadence: once we receive the completed onboarding_form.pdf and a filled minimal_invoice_template.csv sample, allow 3 business days for test ingestion and a vendor record creation.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.docx — covers required fields and sample subject line we mentioned.

If you plan to send consolidated invoices, please call out the file layout as "consolidated_weekly" in the subject so AP flags for manual review the first two cycles.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.docx
